stories.headline: Meta puts Muse at center of AI strategy
stories.summary: Meta says Muse gained more than 10 million US and Canadian users in six weeks and plans non-voting shares to support AI investment. Revenue beat estimates, but quarterly free cash flow turned negative as spending rose.

stories.headline: Tesla targets public Cybercab sales this year
stories.summary: Tesla aims to sell steering-wheel-free Cybercabs by year-end while NHTSA examines how they comply with existing safety rules. The company says scaling is manageable, but it has until October 30 to answer the agency.

stories.headline: Supreme Court rulings reshape midterm map
stories.summary: Recent election rulings have generally helped Republican redistricting and spending priorities, though the court also blocked some GOP-backed maps and mail-ballot limits. Experts expect further litigation after voting.

stories.headline: Houthi attacks raise Gulf escalation risk
stories.summary: Fresh attacks killed people at a Saudi airport and oil field, prompting Saudi retaliatory strikes and US diplomatic drawdowns. Iran separately reported vessel attacks; independent confirmation of several claims remains limited.

stories.headline: Ukraine backs ceasefire and trilateral talks
stories.summary: Zelenskiy supports a ceasefire and talks with the US and Russia after Washington's envoy met Putin. Moscow agreed to resume US-mediated discussions as soon as next month, but no ceasefire terms have been agreed.
